KEY PRODUCT FEATURES:
• 30 Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Boosters
• 1 box topper card
• Best MTG booster to open just for fun
• 12 Magic: The Gathering cards per booster
• 1–4 Rares and/or Mythic Rares in every booster
• Return to the gothic horror plane of Innistrad for a sumptuous vampire wedding—as honored guest or delicious entrée

DESCRIPTION:
The Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Booster Box contains 30 Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Boosters and 1 box topper card. Each Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token, ad card, Helper card, or special card from Magic's history (a card from "The List"). Each pack contains a combination of 1–4 Rares and/or Mythic Rares, 2–7 Uncommons, 3–8 Commons, and 1 Land card. One non–Art Card and non–Land card of any rarity is a traditional foil. A foil-stamped Signature Art Card replaces the Art Card in 5% of Set Boosters. A card from The List replaces the token or ad card in 25% of Set Boosters.
